evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of tear.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: There are linear signal intensity in anterior and posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface and relatively small size of posterior horn, in favor of tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Osteoarthritis of right knee with synovitis; more severe at lateral compartment.
evidence.Lateral OA: Osteoarthritis of right knee with spur and subchondral cysts and subchondral edema in lateral femoral condyle; wearing of articular caritlage,grade 3-4.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: subchondral edema in lateral femoral condyle
